reference_fasta.title: Reference Fasta
reference_fasta.description: Required if genome_build == 'other', defaults available for hg38 and hg19

gridss_blacklist.title: Blacklist Bed File
gridss_blacklist.description: Required if genome_build == 'other', defaults available for hg38 and hg19

gridss_properties.title: GRIDSS Property Files
gridss_properties.description: GRIDSS property files from their github. Can supply custom properties if desired

run_manta.title: Run Manta
run_manta.description: Include Manta in the consensus call

run_lumpy.title: Run LUMPY
run_lumpy.description: Include LUMPY (via smoove) in the consensus call

run_svaba.title: Run SvABA
run_svaba.description: Include SvABA in the consensus call

run_delly.title: Run DELLY
run_delly.description: Include DELLY in the consensus call

run_gridss.title: Run GRIDSS
run_gridss.description: Include GRIDSS in the consensus call. Turning this off also skips all GRIDSS reference/blacklist/PoN requirements above

consensus_min_support.title: Consensus Minimum Support
consensus_min_support.description: Minimum number of enabled callers that must agree on an SV to keep it. Leave blank to require all enabled callers (n/n). Must not exceed the number of enabled callers
